name: Reclaimed Treasures
summary: Patrick Garrett asks you to recover his family treasure from Uldaman. He is waiting for it in the Undercity.

sections.title: A Family Chest
sections.body: The family chest is in Uldaman's South Common Hall. Patrick Garrett waits in the Undercity for the treasure kept inside.

faq.q: Who is asking for the treasure?
faq.answer: Patrick Garrett asks you to bring him his family treasure in the Undercity.
The family chest is in the South Common Hall of Uldaman.

faq.q: Where do I bring the treasure?
faq.answer: Bring Patrick Garrett's family treasure to him in the Undercity.
